create_wav2vec2_model: create a Wav2Vec2Model from a Wav2Vec2Config using the create_wav2vec2_model factory function
create_wav2vec2_encoder: create a TransformerEncoder or Conformer encoder from a Wav2Vec2EncoderConfig using Wav2Vec2EncoderFactory
create_wav2vec2_frontend: create a Wav2Vec2Frontend with feature extractor and position encoder from encoder config
create_wav2vec2_masker: create a StandardWav2Vec2Masker with temporal and spatial masking parameters from config
create_wav2vec2_quantizer: create a GumbelWav2Vec2VectorQuantizer with codebook settings from the model config
